Agent response: That's a great question to consider when giving a gift! We want to make sure the recipient is happy with their Namesake product. Here's how an exchange would typically work: Initiating an Exchange: If the recipient wishes to exchange an item they received as a gift, they would simply select “Returning a gift?” on our Namesake Returns Portal. Item Condition: To be eligible for an exchange, items must be in new condition, with original packaging, and with all tags attached. Please note that if a product is modified in any way, it will be ineligible for return or exchange. For mattresses, they must remain unopened and in their original packaging. We require the original item to be received back at our facilities before the new item can be shipped out. An email confirmation will be sent when the returned item is processed, followed by a new tracking email for the exchanged item. Shipping Costs: If the original order did not include the Free Returns & Exchange Coverage, the recipient would be responsible for the cost of the return shipping label. Ineligible Items: Please be aware that some items are final sale and cannot be returned or exchanged.
